chunks: Do they not see the shadows of all things God has created incline to the right and the left, bowing in obeisance to God?

key_terms.عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَالشَّمَائِلِ: to the right and the left

ai.seo_question: What does the movement of shadows signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the universal submission (taslim) of all creation, where the movement of shadows serves as a tangible sign of God's sovereignty. It contrasts the involuntary prostration of inanimate objects with the conscious submission of humans, urging believers to recognize the divine order in natural phenomena.
